name: evidence-echo
description: Claude Code plugin for evidence-based research digests from the feeds you follow: keeps only articles with measured results, grades each study's level of evidence, checks quotes and the original study. Templates for SEO, AI coding, A/B testing and exercise science.

data_dir.title: Data folder (advanced)
data_dir.description: Where topics and databases live. Leave empty for ~/.evidence-echo. Do not use a cloud-synced folder.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key
anthropic_api_key.description: Optional; enables the api backend (faster, no in-session judging)

voyage_api_key.title: Voyage API key
voyage_api_key.description: Optional; enables embeddings (finds studies with similar text). Without a payment method on the Voyage account the first run is slow
